_readme: Queue of upcoming blog topics. The generator takes the first topic whose id has not been used by a post yet (posts record it as topicId). Reorder, edit, or add entries any time. category = practice area slug (dui, drug-charges, assault-domestic-violence, theft-white-collar, weapons-charges, expungements) or general. location = phoenix, scottsdale, mesa, tempe, or arizona. When the queue runs out, Claude picks a fresh topic automatically. image/imageAlt: featured image for the post (pre-generated with Higgsfield into client/public/blog-images). Topics without one use the practice area's photo.
